bias.en: Uptrend under pressure · lost the 5 and 10-day, at the 30-day
bias.zh: 上升趋势承压 · 失守 5 日和 10 日均线，位于 30 日均线

read.en: Amazon fell 3.9% on Nov 19 to $257.37, reversing from $274.00 to $256.75. It fell below the 5-day ($261.5, falling), 10-day ($263.8) and, narrowly, the 30-day ($257.6), and holds above the 100-day ($255.1) and 200-day ($245.0), all rising. MACD has been above its signal since Nov 4, above zero, histogram at zero and about to cross; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 4 ($249.88), and RSI is 49.0.
read.zh: 亚马逊 11月19日下跌 3.9%，收于 $257.37，盘中从 $274.00 回落至 $256.75。股价跌破 5 日（$261.5，下行）、10 日（$263.8）均线，并以 0.19 美元之差跌破 30 日均线（$257.6），守在 100 日（$255.1）和 200 日均线（$245.0）上方，后三者均在上行。MACD 自 11月4日起位于信号线上方，在零轴上方，柱状图归零、即将交叉；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看多（$249.88），RSI 为 49.0。

read.en: The $274 high was rejected at the $271.5–275.3 band, and the close gave back the 5 and 10-day and the $258.5 support, now resistance. Resistance is $257.6–259.9 (30-day, Nov 17 high), then $261.5–263.8 (5 and 10-day) and $268.3–270.9. Support is $254–256.7 (100-day, Nov 16–19 lows), then $249.9–252.3 (SAR, Nov 5 low) and $244.3–245 (200-day). A close above $259.9 would target $261.5–263.8; below $254, $250–252.

r.en: Nov 18 high $268.29; Nov 13 high $270.05; Nov 10 close $270.87
